title.suggested: Police Gazette's W. E. Harding Dismisses Tom Allen

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican quoted W. E. Harding of the Police Gazette calling the Tom Allen fuss all wind, saying Allen was a total wreck when brought from Boston and was spoiling for a fight with Sullivan.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Friday Morning, January 26, 1883, page 6. Missouri Republican until 1888.

facts.fact: W. E. Harding of the Police Gazette said Allen was spoiling for a fight with John L. Sullivan

notes: The quote is Harding's, not Allen's. Harding also said the Police Gazette brought Allen out from Boston as a 'total wreck'; context unclear, not recorded as a fact.
